curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8012-1-1.pdf (three books in one PDF: torso pages 2-19, legs pages 20-39, arms pages 40-55)

functions.does: The black lever at the top of the back swings the right arm up and down: the lever carries a 20-tooth double bevel gear on its pivot axle, which turns the 16-tooth gear on the right arm's shoulder axle.
functions.source: book: torso pages 7-9 (the gear sub-assembly, steps 1-9; the inset on page 9 has a red arrow for the turn) and step 18 (page 9); arms book step 17 (page 54, the arm's axle into the shoulder); a set review also says the lever at the top of the back swings the right arm

functions.does: The left arm swings at the shoulder on a long pin.
Each arm bends at the elbow on a click hinge, which holds where it's set.
functions.source: book: arms book step 8 (page 43, and page 50 for the other arm)

functions.does: A long grey rod runs from each arm's blaster frame up the arm to beside the shoulder.
functions.source: book: arms book steps 7 and 12 (pages 42 and 45), 17 (page 47); inferred: that it does nothing but look like a cable
functions.note: Unsure: whether the rod tilts the blasters as the elbow bends, or is only decoration.

functions.does: A rubber band at the right arm's blasters holds the blaster frame.
functions.source: book: arms book step 12 (page 52); inferred: what it's for
functions.skip: a rubber band only pulls; only matters under force

functions.does: Each leg poses at the hip, knee and ankle on click hinges, each holding where it's set.
functions.source: book: legs steps 6, 12 and 18 (pages 22, 24 and 27; the other leg's steps 7, 13 and 19 on pages 30, 32 and 35)
functions.note: the controls are each leg's thigh, shin and foot, left leg first; the hinge pins are p2387, p2369 and p2352 (left) and p2440, p2422 and p2405 (right)

functions.does: A grey rod hangs from each hip's round plate down the front of the thigh, sliding through a guide above the knee as the leg bends.
functions.source: book: legs steps 21 and 23 (pages 36 and 38, red arrows show the rod going into the guide)

questions.question: Does the blaster rod tilt the blasters?
